messages:
Asha (recruiter): quick heads-up 11 candidate: Luca F. (senior infra eng), relocating from IE -> US, strong offer from competitor. originally scoped L5 low-mid. candidate has asked for market match. can we get an exception? tracker: O-2031-112. link to brief: https://redwood.app/drive/notes/LucaF_comp.pdf

Lee - People Ops: thanks Asha. please paste proposed numbers and expected start window. any visa/relocation complications? note that >15% base increase needs committee.

Asha (recruiter): proposed: base planned $180,000 -> requested $210,000 (+16.6%), equity 3.5% 4y, sign-on $12k, relocation assistance up to $8k. candidate prefers start ~2026-06-01 but can do a 3-week notice. no visa (EU passport).

Ravi (ENG-Mgr): support. Luca's repo and perf artifacts look excellent; his work could speed up cold-start latency experiments. recommend approving if comp OK.

Morgan (Comp): flagged. +16.6% is just over the flex cap. alternative: approve a phased bump: +10% base ($198k) + $8k sign-on + $6k relocation bonus, and a market adjustment bonus of $6k payable after 6 months tied to performance. this keeps FY27 run-rate lower and gives candidate the cash. i'll draft memo for committee. @Lee please loop finance.

offers-bot: Offer tracker updated 1 status: committee_requested. https://redwood.app/offers/O-2031-112

Lee - People Ops: routing to comp committee. Committee meets tomorrow 08:00 PT. Morgan: please use comp_committee_template.md and include run-rate delta. cc finance (finance-ops@redwood.ai). Also note we need background check vendor for international address confirmation.

Morgan (Comp): pasted memo snippet:
```
Candidate: Luca F. Role: Senior Infra (L5) Manager: Ravi. Proposal: phased approval to balance competitiveness and budget. Approve: base $198,000 (10% lift), sign-on $8k (50/50), relocation $6k, market adj $6k at 6mo. Budget impact: FY27 run-rate +$48k. Request: committee approval for phased package.
```

Lee - People Ops: finance (Jordan) acknowledges run-rate acceptable. moving to committee. @VP-people FYI for expedite.

Ravi (ENG-Mgr): we'll hold verbal at the phased frame ($198k + $8k sign-on) until committee completes. candidate is OK to hold for 48h.

Asha (recruiter): candidate verbal: "happy to move forward if we can land around $200k total cash in year one". i'll upload draft offer packet if approved. thx all.

offers-bot: Committee outcome: APPROVED (2026-04-05 08:12:42 PT) 1 phased package approved. Offer packet: https://redwood.app/offers/O-2031-112/packet

Lee - People Ops: Approved. Asha please extend formal offer per packet. i'll create onboarding checklist and start background check. marking thread resolved :white_check_mark:
